notes.title: Update: January 2, 2017
notes.notes:
Happy New Year~! 

To start off Heartomics: Lost Count has added new music to 
it's library. On top of this a new feature has been added. That's right a cheat 
system is now in place to help those of you needing that extra boost to get 
to the next stage. Unfortunately, using cheats will disable achievements and 
leaderboards. For now the cheat is very easy to find/figure out. As time passes 
let's add more easter eggs and unique variations to the game through this new 
system.

notes.title: The Official Heartomics Fan Club
notes.notes:
Hello everyone. I find it difficult to manage the groups that are created within a game. So instead I will be using the 'Official Heartomics Fan Club' Steam Group to announce contests, giveaways, and twitch streams (speed runs, giveaways, casual chat).

I will still respond to any discussions and comments held here.

Link to Group: https://steamcommunity.com/groups/heartomics
